verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine, so CPU-architecture coverage is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence lists only iOS, Android, Windows (C++ + Vulkan) and macOS targets, with nothing about PowerPC or other non-x86/ARM CPUs. The pluggable backend facade with a reserved CUDA slot is a developer building block, not shipped support for other architectures, so it earns no credit.
